messages.author: 8156fdd09adbc581
messages.subject: Spatial dependence in residuals
parts:
Hello,
I'm working to determine if there is any spatial dependence in pcount
model residuals. The residuals of my model are a matrix which
corresponds with the observation data matrix.
1) Does the pcount model produce abundance estimates per site per
occasion? If so, then per site abundance is the mean across all
sampling occasions?
2) Is it appropriate to calculate the mean residual across occasions
per site, from which I can calculate variograms?
Thanks!
--Neil

messages.author: 681fb59733e01a1e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Spatial dependence in residuals
parts:
hi Neil,
  the abundance parameter is SITE specific only. i.e., N[i] = population size for point i.
 The fitted values, however, are "nsites x nreps" -- i.e., the matrix that comes out of fitted(pcount.obj)

 (2) It seems reasonable to calculate the mean residual that way.

regards,
andy
